is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses exclusively on human head lice, Pediculus humanus capitis.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports kdr mutations in Pediculus humanus capitis, not Anopheles mosquitoes.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The study reports genotype data for Pediculus humanus capitis, not Anopheles mosquitoes.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Iran, which is not in Africa.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection districts in Ardebil, East Azerbaijan, West Azerbaijan, and Zanjan Provinces, Iran.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The collection period is stated as 2016–2021, which is a 6-year window.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new study of head lice in Iran.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigates permethrin resistance and kdr mutations in human head lice (Pediculus humanus capitis) collected in northwestern Iran. It is ineligible because it does not study Anopheles malaria vectors.
